trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Chikmagalur, M.C.No.196/2013
case_name: Smt. Rajamma @ Rajalakshmi vs Sri. H C Shivamurthy
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife sought dissolution of marriage under Section 13(1)(ia)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 on grounds of cruelty and desertion. Trial court dismissed the petition.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle their disputes through conciliation and compromise.
legal_principles.held: At the intervention of elders and well-wishers, the appellant-wife and the respondent-husband, in the conciliation, have arrived at an amicable settlement of the dispute.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order XXIII Rule 3

legal_principles.principle: Parties can withdraw all allegations and cases made against each other as part of a compromise.
legal_principles.held: Both the parties shall withdraw all the allegations and cases made against each other and shall not institute any fresh proceedings hereinafter.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order XXIII Rule 3

legal_principles.principle: Parties can agree not to claim maintenance or alimony against each other as part of a compromise.
legal_principles.held: Neither the appellant nor Respondent shall claim any maintenance or alimony against each other and the present compromise petition shall be treated as final and full settlement of all their claims.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order XXIII Rule 3

legal_principles.principle: Parties can agree not to interfere with each other's personal lives as part of a compromise.
legal_principles.held: Both the parties shall not interfere with personal lives of each other hereinafter. They shall not create any situations which may defame or lower the reputation of parties or their family members in the society.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order XXIII Rule 3

outcome.final_order: Marriage dissolved as prayed for; parties agreed to withdraw all allegations and cases against each other, not institute any fresh proceedings, and not claim maintenance or alimony against each other.

keywords: Latin Maxim: Nemo dat quod non habet
